guess-who-they-miss-now.copied_text: Samantha, the high school basketball team manager, is framed and killed. Reborn at the moment when suspicion first arose, Samantha makes a different choice: she leaves the basketball team and joins the ice hockey team, where she finally discovers her own worth. Only then does the basketball team realize how indispensable she was—but by then, it is far too late.

fear-her-my-mom-s-the-lady-boss.copied_text: Claire suffers constant abuse from her fiancé and his family, never knowing that her mother, whom she believes is only a janitor, is actually Lady Thunder—the legendary founder of a trillion-dollar empire. When her daughter is pushed to the brink, Lady Thunder returns from hiding to crush her enemies, expose impostors, and reclaim her throne. But when a fake heiress steals Claire's identity, an explosive battle for power, family, and revenge begins.

lady-diamond-s-lost-heiress-returns.copied_text: To save her mother Maria, young Bella Rossi sacrifices herself to the mafia. Twenty years later, Maria has become "Lady Diamond," a powerful mogul searching for her lost child. Meanwhile, Bella is betrayed at her own wedding by her fiancé, Vince, who steals her savings to marry another woman. When Maria recognizes Bella's birthmark while Bella is being humiliated at her wedding,  she unleashes her power to protect her daughter and crush their enemies.

no-escape-as-the-dragon-king-s-mate.copied_text: On a rainy Valentine's night, Lydia, a human nurse, saves a bleeding stranger, only to discover he's Soren—the ruthless Dragon King. His ultimatum is brutal: become his fated mate or die. Dragged into a lethal supernatural world, Lydia finds her defiance melting into burning desire as she glimpses the vulnerable heart beneath the tyrant's scales. With the 30-day contract ending, will she claim her freedom, or surrender to the Dragon King forever?

think-again-i-m-the-hidden-boss-mom.copied_text: After PTA (Parent Teacher Association) moms target and frame her son, a "nobody" mom is humiliated and cast aside—as an even bigger secret unfolds behind the scenes... until they discover she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now, she decides their fate.

ruling-over-all-i-see.copied_text: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

i-m-nothing-but-a-mortal.copied_text: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.

forever-was-a-lie.copied_text: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

watch-out-i-m-the-lady-boss.copied_text: After being cast aside by the man she helped rise to power, Eleanor—secret CEO of the powerful Thunder Circle—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.

fake-dating-my-rich-nemesis.copied_text: When a sassy high school girl returns to North Lake High, she doesn't expect to have a one-night mistake with the Beaumont heir, her childhood nemesis, and later team up with him to piss off their exes. Will they eventually fall in love?

addicted-to-your-kiss.copied_text: Ruth Larson's family sells her off to Logan Harlow for money. He icily says that he won't touch her. But when they run into each other at the club, he downs her alcohol in a jealous fit. Ruth asks him to mind himself. But he responds in an aggrieved tone, "Why? Are you scared of others finding out you're married?" This confuses Ruth. Didn't he say they would be divorced in a month? What is he playing at now?

one-fateful-night-with-my-boss.copied_text: After having a one-night stand with an old geezer for money, Anita said goodbye to this cold city and went abroad. Six years later, she comes back with her son and bumps into the legendary CEO, Tristan, who later turns out to be her new boss. Before she knows it, her son starts calling this handsome new boss: “dad”. Could this be fate?

reveal-rise-and-reign.copied_text: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.

the-wedding-day-divorce.copied_text: On Tyson Jordan’s wedding day, his sister, Taylor, returns from abroad to celebrate, only to be mistaken by his fiancée for his secret pregnant lover. Despite Taylor's attempts to clarify the misunderstanding, the fiancée harbors resentment and deliberately causes Taylor's miscarriage. When Tyson learns the truth, he vows to seek revenge for his sister, compelling his fiancée’s family to face the consequences of her reckless actions.

tied-to-my-dangerous-mafia-husband.copied_text:
“Lauren, you're pregnant with twins..." Having lost her memory, Laurent returns to the country to search her father and foster brother with only a necklace as a clue. She thinks she could put up with Vivian and Jacob's harassment for the work visa, but all she got is nonstop abuse and insults. In a turn of fate, Laurent ends up spending another night with Ryan after being fired. 
"You're the Lor?"

love-me-all-you-like.copied_text: When an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Sara finds herself pulled into Elliot’s world of luxury and privilege. As he repeatedly steps in to help her—saving her from an ex, offering her a place to stay, and supporting her during family conflicts—their connection deepens. Despite their differences, Sara and Elliot decide to marry, confronting the realities of their contrasting worlds and discovering love where they least expected it.

waking-up-married-to-my-crush.copied_text: Jasmine awoke to find herself married her college crush Patrick – who is both handsome and wealthy! Yet, she quickly discovers that her marriage is sinking. A tragic accident had damaged her brain, erased the last few years of her life, trapping her at the age of 21. Determined not to spend her 25th year as a love-struck, subservient wife, Jasmine decides to reclaim her sparkle. This transformation gives Patrick a new perspective on Jasmine, he starts to fall in love with her

ascension-to-the-lost-throne.copied_text: After defeating the Killer Sect, the Lord of War, Harry White, is forced to leave the War Sect with his wife due to family conflicts. Unexpectedly, the Killer Sect rejuvenates and collaborates with Harry’s brother, John White, to take him down. Even Harry’s wife betrays him and stands against him. Thanks to Mary Norris, Harry stands a chance to win this battle.

her-journey-beyond-the-script.copied_text: Charlotte Chase has been whisked into a romance novel! Unfortunately, she takes the role of the antagonist whose every move and decision is rife with… well, stupidity. It is apparent that "Charlotte Chase" was only written to show how much better the Female Lead is. Her inescapable ending, as decided by the book, is death.Charlotte knows she has to get out of the Male Lead, Fred's, life before she is dragged into a whirlwind of power plays and conspiracies.

hidden-hero-his-time-to-shine.copied_text: As Logant’s top researcher, Nathan Kent takes part in the Kunst Program, a secret national security operation. All participants unselfishly devote themselves to the operation for the good of the country. However, when Nathan’s teacher dies from exhaustion, a top celebrity and his assistant ask Nathan to empty the ward and even humiliate him.

harvest-of-ambition-a-ceo-s-odyssey.copied_text: After five years of working hard in the city, Derek Larsen becomes the CEO of Gilmore Group and orders the acquisition of all unsold vegetables in Ashville. Unexpectedly, his actions are met with doubt and mockery from his family and acquaintances instead of appreciation. His wife, Nina Hart, arrives to meet him in her secret lover, Simon Hall’s, car and claims that the acquisition is Simon’s deed.

back-to-the-80s.copied_text: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

spoiling-my-sweet-wife-to-her-core.copied_text: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.

sweetheart-wife.copied_text: Four years ago, Queenie Young was framed by Sandy Young and driven abroad by her father. She coincidentally rescued Shane Lawson abroad.Returning home four years later, Queenie found her fiance, Sam Fowler, cheating on her with Sandy. She impulsively married her best friend, Xander Lawson, but Xander took the wrong ID card because he was drunk. They accidentally registered Queenie's marriage with the male lead, Shane.

shes-the-apple-of-their-eye.copied_text: Emily, the daughter of the illustrious Porter family, had her world upended when she learned she wasn't her parents' biological daughter. When the true Porter family heiress returned to claim her birthright, Emily was kicked out of the family. After rejoining her biological family, she discovered she was the heiress of the nation's wealthiest dynasty. She had five exceptional brothers who showered her with affection, two adoring parents, and a wealthy CEO fiancé.

the-lovers-saga.copied_text:
When Carmelia Sanders stepped in for Maeve Turner at the After Hours Club, a twist of fate led her into a night with Asher Lowery. However, Maeve took credit for Carmelia's encounter with Asher.  
Asher woke up and found the pendant that Carmelia had left behind, becoming convinced that Maeve was the daughter of his savior. He deeply adored Maeve and even promised to make her his bride.

rebel-in-devil-s-shackle.copied_text: Sold out by someone in dark web, Nina Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Max Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Nina is now dragged into inferno by Max, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Max confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.

revenge-marriage-sweet-love.copied_text: Cate's sister Rebecca had not only stolen her boyfriend Ethan, but had also stripped her of her inheritance. Fueled by desire for revenge, a drunken Cate impulsively decided to seduce Ethan's handsome uncle, Shaun, who later was ignited by Cate and fell madly in love despite his cold demeanor. However, when they both realized Shaun was mistaken as Ethan's uncle, Shaun realized that she initially approached him only for revenge against Ethan, putting their love to the test.

loved-twice-by-the-hockey-star.copied_text: Seven years after vanishing with his unborn child, Hazel retuirns under a new identity, struggling to save her sick daughter. Alexander, the hockey supersttar who never stopped searching for the woman he lost, has no idea the little girl calling hhim "Daddy" is his own. As buried secrets resurface and old wounds reopen, can love survivethe truth-or is it already too late?

the-son-who-returned-to-expose-their-sha.copied_text: After five years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, Liam Foster returns to the family who sacrificed him to protect their adopted son, Colin. They still call Liam a criminal—but this time, he has proof. As Colin’s lavish celebration begins, a restored surveillance video threatens to expose the lie that ruined Liam’s life—and the family that chose the wrong son.

the-godfather-s-heartbroken-lover.copied_text: For five years, Evelyn believed Mafia godfather Dante Moretti loved her—until his first love returned and one cruel choice shattered everything. Humiliated and heartbroken, Evelyn disappears to Berlin, determined to rebuild her life. But Dante, a man feared by everyone, refuses to let her go. As obsession turns into regret and another man offers her the safety Dante never could, one question remains: when the Godfather finally learns how to love, will it already be too late?

the-mafia-lost-his-queen.copied_text: On her ninth anniversary, Aria's mafia husband, Dominic, forces her to serve his pregnant mistress, leading to a tragic miscarriage. Heartbroken, Aria fakes her death and escapes to London, falling for Caleb, her loyal protector. When Dominic realizes his mistake, he abandons his mistress and chases Aria across the world, begging for mercy. But at her wedding to Caleb, Dominic’s bloody pleas mean nothing. Aria happily walks away, leaving her toxic ex kneeling in his own tears.

too-late-im-married-to-the-godfather.copied_text: Five years after Ethan humiliated Mia with a soda-can tab ring and chose Sophia, Mia is now married to Antonio Russo, the powerful New York Mafia Don, and raising their son. At a luxury hotel, Ethan mistakes her for a beggar and Sophia frames her as a thief, until Antonio reveals Mia is the Donna of the Russo family. Old lies unravel: Sophia destroyed their past and nearly had Mia assaulted. As Sophia falls into ruin and Ethan loses everything, Mia chooses her new family and freedom.

i-slept-with-my-exs-best-friend.copied_text: Claire thought Daniel was hers—until freshman Hannah dared to kiss him in front of everyone, and Daniel chose Hannah over his own girlfriend. Humiliated, Claire dumped him on the spot. Daniel laughed, sure his perfect good girl would come back. Then his best friend Marcus drew the wildest dare: take any girl home. In front of everyone, Marcus reached for Claire. She took his hand for revenge. But one reckless night turns dangerous—Daniel wants her back, and Marcus refuses to let go.

downgrade-my-ride-i-ll-upgrade-my-groom.copied_text: On her wedding day, Eleanor Vance expects to step into the bridal Rolls-Royce. Instead, her fiancé Julian orders her into a cramped backup SUV so his “carsick” secretary Sophia can ride beside him. Humiliated in front of guests and filmed by jealous coworkers, Eleanor refuses to break. When a staged car accident keeps her from the ceremony, Sophia steals her gown, her aisle, and Julian’s kiss. But Eleanor has one card left: Christian Thorne, her childhood best friend and the powerful heir who has loved her for years. Within an hour, Eleanor and Christian are legally married. Then they return to the reception with a marriage certificate and a smile. Julian thinks he can still control the bride he discarded. He has no idea she is done begging for respect. This time, Eleanor is upgrading more than her ride—she is upgrading her whole life forever, and destroying his empire too.

no-taste-for-blood.copied_text:
Philadelphia’s popular Crimson Café is known for its creamy signature drink. Its secret is not milk, but a young girl’s blood collected daily in a crystal cellar bowl.
Seraphina, imprisoned for years by her foster parents, escapes and runs into a vampire Duke. She saved his life with her blood ten years ago, and he has searched for her ever since. But a strange scent chills him when she offers her wrist.
The Vampire Tribunal comes for them with torture, pyres and ancient rites. Her blood heals and resurrects and resonates with the Progenitor’s lingering spirit. Still, she suspects she is just a pawn on someone’s chessboard.
While fighting vampire nobles, she discovers a secret mastermind drew her into a trap. This entity knows her lineage, powers and preordained fate.
Will she be the board’s most valuable piece, or the one to overturn everything? Between blood slave and queen lies great power, along with a lie she has never questioned.

the-muggle-kingpin.copied_text: The post-apocalypse is swarming with monsters, and humanity clings to life by a thread. Zane, a muggle with zero powers, is exiled by his own kin. Then he stumbles into running a supply mart and discovers he can control the very beasts hunting humans. Can this rejected underdog become the savior no one saw coming?

clans-at-war.copied_text: A poor boy took his daughter to a martial arts competition to find a wife, but the beautiful CEO despised him because he was a beggar and looked down on him. The next second, the poor boy just moved his fingers and killed everyone in the audience. It turned out that his real identity was the Invincible Immortal, and the beauty was conquered on the spot!

destined-reunion.copied_text: Logan Campbell's desperate search for Ruby and young Nolan ignites family turmoil, marriage pressure, and questions of bloodline. At a grand birthday feast, a child's bold claim sparks the revelation of a hidden son. Secrets unravel, ties are tested, and the Campbell legacy is pushed to the brink of change.

medical-genius-is-not-someone-to-mess-wi.copied_text: After sacrificing her career for her family, Grace discovered her husband Raymond's affair with Vanessa and their love child. Forced into a destitute divorce, she made a triumphant return to medicine, becoming the renowned director of Apollo Medical Centre. When Raymond's son, Julian, was admitted with a critical aortic aneurysm, Grace agreed to operate despite their abuse. Raymond's family, distrustful of her skills, harassed her and permanently injured her gifted surgical hand. This prevented the life-saving surgery, leading to Julian's death. Even afterwards, the family continued their torment. During a confrontation at a formal dinner, a shocking truth emerged: Julian was not Raymond's biological son!

i-helped-my-husbands-brother-take-the-ma.copied_text: A reborn mafia wife was drowned by her husband for ruining his first love’s birthday. This time, she lets him blow the entire godfather throne for his sweetheart, then strikes a deal with his exiled brother to take everything. Savage karma, brutal payback, no mercy.

mommy-i-m-not-lying-updating.copied_text: Evelyn forces her twins to wear "truth band". When Lily dies from an ignored allergy, the device stays red, leading Evelyn to accuse her corpse of "faking it". Even after being arrested, the delusional mother shrieks at Lily’s ghost, still branding her a "liar".

back-with-baby-ex-regrets-deeply.copied_text: Vanessa was dumped by her fiancé Seth at the clerk's office. She married billionaire Grayson in an arranged marriage abroad. Three years later, she returns with their son, faces humiliation from Seth and Chloe, and Grayson's brutal revenge reveals his long-hidden love for her.

the-ceo-who-felt-my-pregnancy.copied_text: Lila Reed, a poor rural‑born employee at Vaughn Group, sleeps with drugged CEO Hayden Vaughn to land a permanent job. A unique family mating bond lets Hayden share all her physical sensations. When Lila finds herself pregnant with high‑risk triplets, she tries to run away. Hayden finds her, marries her and shields her from jealous rivals, malicious coworkers and greedy family members. After surviving multiple dangers, Hayden proposes to Lila. Connected by their special bond, they look forward to their life with the unborn triplets.

married-my-sister-s-groom-and-make-him-r.copied_text: To save her dying grandmother, Hannah agrees to pose as her twin sister for three years, enduring a loveless marriage, her husband's cruelty to her, and obsession with his first love. When the deal finally ends and she walks away with the money she deserved, the man who once discarded her realizes too late what he's lost.

fall-for-mafia-boss-who-killed-my-fiance.copied_text: Mafia Don Cesare slaughters Helena's fiancé and family on her wedding day, forcing her into a hellish marriage. For seven years, Helena endures his cruel obsession until she fakes her death and flees pregnant. But when Cesare hunts her down, the bloody truth shatters everything she ever believed...

the-twins-love-me-too-late.copied_text: For three years, Hannah slept beside a stranger — her husband's twin, Ansel — in a marriage built on Aiden's revenge scheme for Ivy. After her mother's death and a miscarriage, Hannah gets her revenge, cuts both brothers out of her life, and starts a new life overseas.

my-gynecologist-is-the-mafia-boss.copied_text: Trapped in a humiliating, sexless marriage, Jenna finds hope in an unexpected place: her mysterious doctor, Wayne, who’s actually ruthless Mafia King. Taking her as his housemaid, he turns a fragile ex-wife into his feared Mafia Queen, destroying everyone who ever wronged her.

dumping-my-mr-april-fools.copied_text: After surviving her ex's cruel April Fools' proposal pranks for six years, Sienna discovers their entire relationship was just a bet. She tosses her ring and flees to Ireland—leaving him broken, weeping, and too late to stop her wedding.

the-siren-the-don-will-never-keep.copied_text: Sold to New York Mafia Godfather Vincenzo at 21, Chloe spent seven years as his gilded mistress and Hollywood siren. But on her 28th birthday, she overhears him call her "just a plaything". Heartbroken, Chloe severs ties, abandons her fame, and flees to Paris to pursue her painting dream. Vincenzo begins to regret his foolish pride and relentlessly tracks her down...

married-an-elven-king-by-mistake.copied_text: Seeing a future of humiliation as the Crown Prince's bride, Vera lets her sister steal him and marries a dwarf instead, only to discover he is the Elven King. Vera’s sincerity wins his heart, turning a lowly bride into a queen, while her sister is exiled to the land of the Dragons to suffer the fate she created.

her-mafia-fathers-wrath.copied_text: My father was Enzo Moretti, the godfather of one of New York’s most powerful mafia families. And I was his princess—his most cherished treasure. He hid me from his world to protect me, but he didn’t want me left alone, so he arranged a marriage for me. The groom was Leon Scott—the son of New York’s richest man. Handsome, loaded, and a rising star in the business world. On paper, he was perfect. For our wedding, my father had a custom gown flown in from a designer in Milan. Today was my fitting appointment. When I walked into the bridal boutique, my heart stopped. Nicole Hill, Leon’s childhood sweetheart, was wearing my wedding dress. When she saw me, a smug little smile curled her lips. Then she grabbed a cheap white polyester bridesmaid’s dress from the table and shoved it into my arms. “Put this on,” she said, lifting her chin like she owned the place. “You can wear this for the ceremony.” I looked down at the flimsy fabric in my hands, then back up at her. My voice dropped low. “I’m the soon-to-be bride. And you’re telling me to wear this?” She let out a laugh, sharp and mean. “Just do what you’re told and don’t make this difficult. Leon already gave the word. I’m walking down the aisle in your place. And you? You just stand there like a good little bridesmaid and go through the motions.” For a few seconds, I couldn’t speak. Then I pulled out my phone and dialed Leon’s number. It rang twice before he picked up. “Leon, about Nicole taking my place at the altar. Don’t you think you owe me an explanation?”

this-time-i-choose-mr-mafia.copied_text: Stella was destroyed by the man she loved and his mistress. Her family, her name, her life were all gone. But fate rewinds the clock. Back at the husband-selection gala, she ditches her ex and shocks everyone by choosing Adrian, the ruthless mafia king no one dares to cross. Adrian gives her power, protection, and passion — until she discovers his secret: he wasn’t her weapon… he was her shield, all along.

from-trash-awakener-to-ocean-god.copied_text: Transmigrated into a monster-infested Ocean Age, Aimar’s SSS-grade Pandora's Box is mocked as worthless trash. Dumped and expelled, he unlocks the artifact—awakening Poseidon and ten ancient gods. Now, the outcast rules the seas, forcing every enemy to bow at his feet.

useless-knight-my-mounts-conquered-every.copied_text:
"Four years as the academy's top prodigy — then he awakens the ""most useless class in existence"": Knight. His girlfriend dumps him on the spot, running straight into the arms of a corporate heir, while the whole hall laughs him out of the room.

What they don't know: his real class is Chronicle Knight — heir to the Throne of Mounts, able to contract legendary steeds from EVERY era in history.

When Odin's mythic warhorse tears open the sky on a rainbow bridge, and a liquid-metal war machine from the future ignites in flame, his enemies drop to their knees begging for mercy. The ""trash"" everyone mocked is now the S-rank legend the entire academy fears.

Mount by mount, he awakens gods, machines, ships, and beasts beyond time. Enemy by enemy, he crushes everyone who doubted him. But the real war is just beginning — an invasion from beyond time itself threatens to erase the entire kingdom. When everyone else retreats, he rides forward with seven eras behind him, the last Knight standing between humanity and extinction.

The day they threw him away was the day his legend began. Now it's their turn to regret it."

hero-husband-s-apocalypse-harem.copied_text: Years after the world is ravaged by an apocalypse, Sam is a nobody struggling to survive until a system appears and changes his life. In order to protect his own life, Sam must learn the true meaning of bravery when he's tasked with safeguarding the lives of three beautiful women, all of whom eventually choose to become his wife.

don-s-daughter-doesn-t-need-a-new-mother.copied_text: As Don's mysterious heiress, Loretta is stepping out of shadows after she's had enough of humiliation from her father's mistress. The moment her true identity is revealed, she'll expose the traitors and corruption within the mafia house, and make everyone who crossed her family pay.

her-kept-husband-was-the-king-of-everyth.copied_text: Bound by a six-year promise, the powerful genie Evren hides his identity and protects his wife, Layla, saving her company from every crisis. Yet she treats him like a useless servant. When the contract expires, Evren walks away—leaving Layla to discover that everything she had was built by the husband she despised.

a-nearsighted-girls-journey-through-a-ho.copied_text: After I got pulled into the horror game, my nearsightedness made everything blurry. I ended up treating the creepy girl in the blood-stained dress like my own daughter, the final boss like my husband, and the old creepy ghosts like my loving parents. The first time I met the boss, I grabbed his abs and said, “Nice body. Shame you’re kind of short.” He actually laughed in anger, picked up the severed head in his hand, put it back on his neck, and ground out, “I’m six-foot-one. Still think I’m short now?”

too-late-to-mourn-our-daughter-alpha.copied_text: On Alpha Kurtis's birthday, he abandoned his Luna, Melanie, and their daughter in a deadly dragon attack just to save his mistress. As her daughter's wolf soul faded into darkness, Melanie severed the Mate Bond, swearing blood vengeance.

a-one-year-marriage-with-the-hockey-star.copied_text: When hockey phenom Ryder Levy is injured and buried in scandal, Robin’s sister bolts before the wedding. Forced to take her place, Robin enters a one-year contract marriage with the man meant to be her brother-in-law. But one season of pretending may turn into forever.

ditched-my-wolf-fiance-for-the-beast-kin.copied_text: Betrayed by her fiancé and adopted sister, nine-tailed fox shifter Wisteria takes her sister’s place and marries the feared Serpent Lord. He becomes the only one who truly loves her. Now a legendary alchemist, Wisteria leaves her ex and family begging for forgiveness she’ll never give.

her-and-her-a-dangerous-affair.copied_text:
Police prodigy Mia goes undercover at the 15th Precinct, tasked by Internal Affairs Director Vance to gather evidence of corruption against Captain Victoria. From day one, Mia endures Victoria's cold hostility and harsh treatment, yet amidst the friction, she finds herself drawn to the captain's unyielding resolve and hidden sense of justice. During a dock raid, Victoria takes a bullet for Mia—an act that shatters Mia's emotional defenses.
Shortly after, a gallery murder rocks the city: the victim is none other than the Oversight Director's only son. As Mia and Victoria join forces to investigate, they uncover a web of deceit—and discover that their seemingly reliable colleague, Leo, is the real mole. Leo lures them to an abandoned chemical plant, rigged with C4 explosives. In the ensuing firefight, Victoria kills him. The case appears closed, but when Mia reports to Vance, she senses something deeply wrong—he shows no surprise at any of the twists, and Leo's personnel file has been systematically erased.
Mia realizes she has been a pawn all along. Vance's true plan is to rebrand Leo as a ""heroic undercover agent"" who died in the line of duty, and use Mia's own firearm as evidence to frame Victoria for murder. Torn between duty and conscience, Mia confesses her undercover identity to Victoria. Devastated and betrayed, Victoria cuts all ties and expels her from the precinct. Vance immediately places Mia under house arrest, threatening her with a forged confession and life imprisonment.
Under 48 hours of relentless psychological pressure, Mia refuses to break. Meanwhile, Victoria works in secret, gathering irrefutable proof of Vance's collusion with the dark web and his fabrication of evidence. At a live televised press conference where Vance intends to pronounce Mia guilty, Victoria storms in with federal agents and exposes his crimes on air. Vance is arrested, and Mia is publicly exonerated.

he-begs-for-the-heart-he-broke-120-times.copied_text: After 120 failed confessions, a tragic fall erases Leona's ten-year love for Everett. Driven by envy, Everett’s ex frames, burns, and imprisons her, but gentle Shane stays by Leona’s side. As Leona thrives, the evil schemes unravel. Everett goes mad with regret, only to realize Leona has moved on.

the-mafia-boss-is-addicted-to-my-touch.copied_text: Six years ago, blindfolded Haley was bedded by Mafia boss Lester. Now ruined by her cheating husband Bill, she signs a healing marriage contract with Lester. Finding out Lester's daughter is her lost newborn secretly sold by Bill, Haley starts a thrilling new life -- slapping down the toxic exes while falling deeply in love with Lester.

this-time-she-walked-away-first.copied_text: Lena Clermont fell hard for her dad's friend, Andrew Rohan—twelve years older. The first time she saw him, he was all sharp suits and broad shoulders, effortlessly standing out. He smiled, patted her head, and handed her a princess dress. Fast forward to twenty. He got drugged at a banquet. She wore that same dress, offering herself as the cure.

reborn-with-my-son-married-to-the-snake-.copied_text: Murdered by her sister and husband, Serena is reborn at the Husband-Choosing Rite. She rejects the treacherous Wolf Heir for Soren, a Serpent Lord rumored brutal and penniless—but actually gentle, devoted, and the realm’s richest man. To protect her child, family, and every clan, Serena unleashes ruthless revenge.

rejected-by-three-alphas-claimed-by-the-.copied_text:
She reached out for help — and all three of her Alphas swam right past her, straight to another woman.
Riley, eighteen, was once the girl three powerful Alphas fought over — her fiancé Chase, her childhood friend Mark, her stepbrother Ethan. Everyone assumed she'd choose one of them as her fated mate. Then a sweet-faced Omega named Chloe appeared, and everything changed. They shattered their blood bond with her, chained her in a dungeon as a living ""blood bag,"" and drained her veins with a syringe — all to heal Chloe's face. To everyone, she was nothing but a ""wolf-less freak.""
Until the Blood Moon rose. The Moon Spirit, asleep for ten thousand years, awakened inside her — revealing that Riley was the true Lycan Queen, the one who reigns above every Alpha. On the night her silver hair blazed to life, the whole hall knelt at her feet. She left them just one line: ""None of you. I choose no one.""
She turned away, took the Blood Moon Crown, and married the empire's most powerful ruler — Alex Reed, the cursed Lycan King who'd worn a silver muzzle for ten years, a beast who'd endure a thousand needles through his heart before ever hurting her. She purged his Godslayer curse with her sacred blood; he burned her enemies to ash with royal flame. When the three men who betrayed her crawled back begging, when the truth of the Omega's every crime came to light — their Blood Moon wedding became her most breathtaking reckoning.
From a discarded girl trampled into the mud, to a goddess ruling the world beside her King. This time, they kneel and look up at her.

mommy-my-new-dad-is-the-dragon-king.copied_text: While taking care of her sick son and dealing with her cheating husband, Jessica, a low-level white dragon and trainer, finds herself crossing dangerous paths with her husband's mistress who wants her dead and the King of Dragons who will do anything to protect her.

from-zero-to-hero-the-x-ray-eyed-surgeon.copied_text: Bullied and broke, intern doctor Tristan Rourke gains X-ray vision after an accident. Now he can see hidden diseases, expose every scheme, and save lives no one else can. From nobody to medical legend, Tristan even foresees a deadly earthquake—and chooses saving the world over wealth.

from-loving-wife-to-bloodthirsty-queen.copied_text: She gave up her crown and immortality for love—and he repaid her with betrayal and murder. Now the Queen of the Night rises from the grave to reclaim everything. Her groveling ex wants her back, but another guardian already stands at her throne.

the-billionaire-s-baby-making-cowgirl.copied_text: Daisy Mae comes from a magical village where women are naturally blessed with extraordinary fertility. She unexpectedly marries billionaire heir Silas Sterling, whose family desperately needs an heir. But the Sterlings are cursed. Every woman who bears their heir dies. Can they break the curse and safely give birth to their heir?

the-tennis-queen-s-match-point-comeback.copied_text: After five years of marriage to her tennis partner Enzo, Isabel uncovers a devastating truth: she was merely a shadow of Julie, the woman he never forgot.Enzo abandons everything when Julie returns. But when Isabel vanishes from his life, desire turns to torment—and regret comes far too late.

racing-back-to-your-heart.copied_text: Six years ago, Hazel was pregnant. She left without looking back. She wanted to protect Jace's racing career. Six years later, they meet again. Jace's love has turned to hatred. He uses every ruthless trick to keep Hazel by his side.....

don-t-touch-the-legendary-lawyer-s-grand.copied_text: Lawyer Eleanor flies with her sick grandson to surgery. Oversold flight: influencer Bella steals his seat, flashing her boyfriend's platinum card, unaware she's bullying his mother, the Queen of Lawyers. Crew gag the child, lock him in a lavatory; the purser keeps the key as she begs on her knees. One films it. Off the plane, she vows they pay.

the-slave-who-became-dragon-king.copied_text: Swapped at birth, Arthur, the true dragon heir, is raised as a slave while a fraud steals his crown. But true blood can't be hidden. When his supreme golden dragon power awakens, Arthur will crush the imposter, reclaim his desstined queen, and rise from the mud to rule the realm!

the-hidden-queen-my-husband-s-mistress-r.copied_text: A hidden heiress of Sinclair family builds her husband into a luxury tycoon—until his affair with the restaurant manager and a viral electro-eel attack expose his betrayal. Revealing her true identity, she destroys the empire she built for him.

double-marked-luna-s-revenge.copied_text: Luna Talia gave everything to protect her husband, Carter, but he secretly marked Ellie. Manipulated by Ellie's scheme, he stuffed her in a sack, and tortured her without mercy. Clinging to her last breath, Talia rejected him and left behind a moonstone necklace carrying the truth… and a set of divorce papers. Then she walked away. For good.

galactic-myth-arena.copied_text: Earth has forgotten its gods. After centuries of lost history and crushing defeats in a galactic arena, humanity faces enslavement. Ethan Cole, a delivery driver from another world who remembers Earth's myths, must awaken its lost deities to face alien civilizations armed with powerful gods and rigged rules.

back-to-95-her-big-comeback.copied_text: In 2026, top designer Fiona dies and wakes up in 1995 as an obese, despised wife whose husband, Carter, wants a divorce. Using her future fashion sense, she sheds weight, pays debts, and builds a fashion empire. Witnessing her independence, Carter fights to win her back. Ultimately, they reunite at the top.

not-your-average-crow.copied_text: Emily believes she is a lowly crow who accidentally lands in a phoenix nest. Adopted by Queen Angelina, she keeps trying to escape before a trial exposes her. But when the Magic Mirror shatters and Hellfire dies around her, Emily learns she is the long-lost Abyssal Phoenix—and uncovers a plot threatening her new family.

from-doomed-baby-to-packs-darling.copied_text: Mia wakes inside a werewolf novel as an abandoned pup, rescued by the Hawthornes—a family doomed to be destroyed by Serena. She vows to save them, unaware that Marcus, Ethan, and Ryan hear her every thought. Her warnings save Ryan's falcon and spare Cole from a three-wolf ambush—but also reveal to Serena that they can hear Mia's thoughts. While the Hawthornes race to Cole, Serena locks Mia in, drains her Fortune, and raises a silver blade. Ethan reaches the door—but can he save Mia in time?

the-king-of-vegas-chose-her-i-chose-free.copied_text: Evelyn left her wealthy family to build an empire with Cole, the man she loved. But when he cheated and destroyed her body for his mistress, she divorced him, reclaimed her life, and found happiness again—while Cole lost everything.

i-woke-up-with-a-tribe-of-beast-girls.copied_text: IT programmer Ethan transmigrates to a savage wilderness, awakens an encyclopedia and danger-sensing ability, saves the cat-eared tribe with modern knowledge, unites with the wolf-eared clan to found the Lunara tribe, and fights foreign invaders together to seek survival and development.

weak-dragons-covenanted-harem.copied_text: At a wife selection ceremony, Claire, who was despised by her father and brothers, awakened the system of mating and becoming stronger. As long as she mated with the opposite sex, she could continuously become stronger. In the end, she was crowned as the Dragon Lord of both races, holding the harem of beauties from all races, and creating a new era for the Dragon race!

the-bastard-who-shook-olympus.copied_text: Mocked as a powerless bastard with no divine blessing, Arion enters the brutal trials of the Athenian Military Academy. But when he defeats every rival, his three mentors reveal themselves as Athena, Hephaestus, and Prometheus—the gods who chose him. Then Hades’ chosen warlord kidnaps his mother. With only 20 days to save her, Arion must awaken the blood of Ares. Can he become strong enough to defeat a god-blessed warlord?

kiss-of-a-cornered-beast.copied_text: Milo Thompson works multiple jobs—and even sells a kidney—to fund his boyfriend Kane Winslow’s brain surgery. Then he learns Kane is a wealthy Upper East Side heir and their love was only a cruel game. Devastated, Milo disappears. Realizing his feelings were real, Kane gives up his pride and begins a desperate fight for forgiveness.

all-my-pets-that-i-raised-turned-into-da.copied_text: Laila's goal: find her lost "cubs." But creatures she raised are no longer weak. Harry the blood bat is a billionaire vampire progenitor. Fenrir rules werewolves. Groot, the tree spirit who begged to be replanted, became the "World Tree" searching for her. With milk tea and dragonfire, Laila tames ancient bosses, turning monsters into cubs craving attention. Beneath the comedy lies a reunion 500 years overdue: her cubs thought she abandoned them, and Laila is here to prove Mom has come home.

forbidden-vows-my-bestie-s-billionaire-d.copied_text: After her fiancé's scandal ruins her family, destitute Chloe moves in with her best friend Mia — and falls for Mia's cold, domineering billionaire father, Victor. Their forbidden affair ignites; Victor shields her and destroys her ex-fiancé. As exposure looms, Chloe tries to flee, only to be possessively detained by Victor, who refuses to let her go.

claimed-by-my-boyfriend-s-mafia-father.copied_text: A poor college student. A powerful mafia boss. One unforgettable mistake. Rosy Walker’s life changes forever when a birthday surprise goes wrong and leads her into the arms of Leon Vittorio — her boyfriend’s father and the most dangerous man in New York. Now, with secrets, betrayal, and desire pulling them together, there’s no escaping the forbidden love they never saw coming.

dragons-bow-to-the-trash.copied_text: Born without a Dragon Mark, Elias is mocked as a powerless nobody at the Royal Dragon Rider Academy. No one knows he once routed a Level 72 Demon King, commands dragons without a bond, and has awakened Alexstrasza, the ancient King of Dragons. As corrupt nobles rig the trials against him, the academy is about to learn who the real monster is.

the-billionaire-alpha-s-male-wet-nurse.copied_text: To pay for his grandfather's treatment, lop-eared rabbit Omega Lorin becomes a wealthy family's wet nurse. His boss, Wolf King Ryan, is the man he once saved. The Alpha rejects everyone's touch but Lorin's. As rivals scheme against him, Ryan steps in to protect him, drawing them into a dangerous romance.

the-ceos-exclusive-milk-mommy.copied_text: After losing her husband and baby, Ella joins Winter Group, only to discover the woman she once saved with her breast milk is CEO Celine Winter. Celine hires her as a personal assistant and grows obsessed with her. As their secret attraction deepens, jealous Margaret schemes against Ella, putting her in grave danger.

exiled-bride-of-the-border-king-3.copied_text: Fuso attacks, and Jenna Wade swings the badly wounded, unconscious Leonard Quinn like a human weapon—turning the tide overnight. Her ruthless tricks and reforms forge the New Army, crush traitors, and make her Southridge’s uncrowned ruler as Leonard Quinn shifts from opponent to backup. Now she sets sail for Fuso—what awaits her there?

the-janitor-mom-is-the-real-boss.copied_text: Fu Jingshu, head of the Zhuoyuan Group, hides her fortune to temper her adopted son Fu Huai'an, posing as a cleaner to raise him sixteen years. Returning from abroad, he becomes vain under his birth mother Shen Rong. At a banquet, he humiliates her, smashing the heirloom jade pendant. Fu Jingshu reveals her true identity as her three sons arrive. Fu Huai'an learns every resource came from his adoptive mother and kneels in confession. Fu Jingshu cuts the past ties, beginning a brand-new life.

the-reaper-s-fated-bride.copied_text: Reborn after Eros drained her soul fire to death, Elara chooses feared Death god Thanatos over the God of Love at divine spouse selection. Her sister pursues dark arts to birth the prophesied God-Child who will overthrow Zeus; Thanatos sacrifices his lifespan to nourish Elara, who conceives an heir able to sever fate—rewriting destiny and changing the gods' ruler.

clinic-miracle.copied_text: Resident John unexpectedly gains miraculous supernatural powers to see internal injuries in patients. He uncovers multiple hidden critical conditions and saves countless dying patients. However, his extraordinary diagnostic skills draw suspicion and investigation from his peers. Racing against death in the emergency department, he carefully hides his supernatural secret, while danger creeps closer to him.

tamed-a-tyrant-became-his-love.copied_text: A young tyrant pins his regent on his wedding night. The regent, once a modern tutor, raises him into a ruler but becomes the mad king's only weakness. Taming ends with the teacher caged. When rebels attack, he takes a poisoned arrow meant for the king, who howls that he wanted him, not the throne.

snacks-bought-me-a-wasteland-throne-seas.copied_text: A junk snack order flips Ian Chan’s life: a “free ring” drops him into a brutal wasteland. In the real world he’s a Boss; in the wasteland he barters spicy strips for tech and power, rising fast while others barely survive. How far can a pack of spicy strips take him?

exiled-genius-dragon-contract-season-3.copied_text: Cast out after his talent is stripped, Hugh Lowe awakens the Mythic Beast System, contracts the Doom Demon Dragon, and gains an SSS Rank talent. Now he’ll reclaim every debt they owe him—one by one.

exiled-genius-dragon-contract-2.copied_text: Betrayed and stripped of his gift, Evan Lowe is cast out by his own family. Then a Mythic Beast System awakens—he bonds with the Apocalyptic Demon Dragon and unlocks an SSS talent. Cast out once, he’s back to collect every debt they owe—who will pay first?

ten-year-old-cowboy.copied_text: In the lawless Wild West, legendary gunslinger Jake dies shielding gang leader Robert's ten-year-old son Dylan. His spirit is unexpectedly transferred into the boy's frail body. Trapped inside a child's frame, he retains his sharp wits and peerless marksmanship. With Robert murdered, the Morrison Gang falls into chaos; treacherous uncle James plots to seize power while ruthless outlaws close in. Hunted and underestimated, Dylan carries Jake's oath to protect his family and the gang.

the-world-s-deadliest-body-guard.copied_text: Kane Mercer was once the top-ranked killer on the underground assassin registry the Ledger. Three years ago, he retired and became an ordinary freight driver in the American Southwest. When crime boss Victor Crowe massacred his outfit and put a bounty on Tessa Cross, the boss's daughter, Kane was entrusted with protecting her and forced to pick up his old skills. Crowe raises Kane's bounty to three million and draws in top killers.

my-ex-uncle-my-possession.copied_text: Nineteen-year-old Corvina, a good girl, was duped by her spoiled rich boyfriend Tate. Yet in a locked room, she accidentally spent the night with his underworld uncle, Harrison. A sudden police raid dragged her into a maelstrom of taboo uncle-nephew entanglement and criminal conspiracies. As Tate’s false affection and Pace’s malicious schemes pushed her to the brink, only that domineering, powerful man risked his life to protect her time and again. It turned out he was her fated destiny.

space-cowboy-s-royal-escort.copied_text: Caesar, the universe's strongest "Mechanical Man," honors a dying friend's wish by escorting Princess Shirley through deadly territory. Battling the Wild Grass Gang at every turn, he holds the line until reinforcements arrive—keeping his promise, and keeping the people he cares for safe.

the-mafia-dongot-the-wrong-wife-so-i-ran.copied_text: Helena fled in disgrace after a one-night stand with Mafia godfather Cole. Based on the information from a lost delivery, Cole mistakenly identified her stepsister Ivy as Helena. Ivy impersonated her and checked into the estate, but unexpectedly learned that Helena was pregnant. Ivy fed Helena an abortifacient and forged a pregnancy test report. Helena exposed the conspiracy in public, and Cole had to personally find the woman he truly loved amidst his mistakes.

my-pup-became-my-alpha.copied_text: Ten years ago, ace hunter Raven defied his guild's sacred rules to rescue and raise Ash, an orphaned pup from the enemy Moon Wolf clan. Now, the clingy cub has grown into a dominant pureblood Alpha whose suppressed devotion and possessive hunger are spiraling out of control. Torn between age, duty, and taboo boundaries, Raven tries to run—until a fatal crisis forces Ash to execute a permanent mating mark to save Raven's life, shattering the line between guardian and mate forever.

my-billionaire-roommate-is-the-demon-kin.copied_text: Broke painter Emma scores when her gorgeous new roommate pays a year's rent upfront—only rule: never ask his past or open his door. But strange events unmask him as a 900-year-old Demon King posing as a billionaire CEO. An accident binds their souls in an unbreakable pact. Forced into a fake relationship, staged love turns real—just as Emma learns her own origins outshine the demon under her roof.

death-forgot-he-loved-me.copied_text: Thief Lara steals a cursed ring that binds her to an amnesiac Death God. She is his reincarnated lost love; to break the curse, he sacrifices his divinity for mortality, and she anchors his soul back to earth.

my-patient-is-a-mermaid.copied_text: Daniel, a NYC psychotherapist who enters dreams by touch, hypnotizes drenched Elena and discovers she's a deep-sea siren. Siren law forces the "Kiss of Oblivion," which erases both their memories. Three years later, by the ocean, Elena has lost her identity but still calls out Daniel's name—the only memory she keeps—spurring him to reclaim their stolen love.

son-from-the-future.copied_text: When single attorney Emma is cornered at her front door by a stranger claiming to be her son from the future, he issues a bizarre ultimatum: start dating, or die in a car accident in exactly one year. But as Emma investigates to the bottom of his warning, she uncovers a chilling truth—the person destined to die was never her.

alphas-cursed-mate.copied_text: Saved by a serpent guardian, Lila learns she's the Serpent Queen's lost daughter, with sealed 'Silver Scale Blood.' Hunted as magic wakes, she meets Marcus—a werewolf Alpha, her fated mate. Defying his pack and Council, he chooses her. They smash the lab, free her mother, end the millennium war.

our-crew-has-no-tomorrow.copied_text: Six written-off Hollywood rejects shot a zombie phenomenon on a single iPhone that racked up a staggering one billion views overnight. But before the victory champagne even stops flowing, a predatory contract drops on the table: despite a billion hits, they haven't earned a single penny—and instead owe the company millions. The more viral they get, the broke they become. Trapped by their own blockbuster, these nobodies decide it’s time to flip the entire table.

the-bakery-queen-and-her-five-exes.copied_text: Baker Irene has no idea her five persistent exes lead rival mafia dynasties. They secretly form a "Guardians Alliance," taking shifts just to talk to her—until cheating nearly ignites a five-family mob war, while she remains clueless.

i-married-a-family-of-liars.copied_text: A Wall Street con woman, flipped into an FIA informant, marries into a NY elite family as an aristocrat to expose money laundering. Wedding night reveals her in-laws are frauds—black-market title, forged "Monet," Ponzi-scheme fund. When her FIA handler emerges as the real mastermind, she must choose: trade them for freedom, or join the family to take down the criminal.

silent-wrath.copied_text: 'Silence-07', ex-Black Blade killer, hid seven years as a mechanic shielding daughter Lily. Heir Damian covets her; adoptive father Victor sends twelve killers. Fleeing to a border town, he teams with vets as mentors turn on him and conspiracies surface. He faces his bloody past to protect her.

my-boss-is-my-babys-father.copied_text: Pregnant with Lennox Foster’s baby, Nora Shaw can hear her unborn child’s voice and get on-the-spot advice. She lands a job in the Foster home as a gold-medal maternity nanny, caring for their quintuplets while hiding who she is. In Capital City, she’s in demand, but when Lennox learns the truth, can he win Wifey back from five wailing babies?

my-brother-pushed-me-off-a-cliff-so-i-ca.copied_text: Betrayed by brother Kairion, pushed off a cliff—Princess Serlany is saved by werewolf Greysorn. Sacred Blood revives her; she returns as a maid, uncovering Kairion's plot, her father's secret, and the vampire war. As he seizes the crown, Serlany and Greysorn expose his crimes and reclaim her throne.

the-warlords-heir-is-my-son.copied_text: Betrayed and imprisoned, Willa Gray gives birth after a drugged night. Her son Andy is adopted by his unknown father, Young Marshal Jason Shaw, identified as heir by the Kirin Birthmark. Hired as a nanny to soothe the ailing boy, she comes face-to-face with Jason, unaware of their connection.

three-women-one-trap.copied_text: Harvard lawyer Ivy Bennett discovers her husband's infidelity and theft. She teams with two betrayed women—a billionaire heiress and a single mom—for revenge. Posing as a Wall Street tycoon, they lure him into a fake $35M lithium deal. At his launch, they unmask him, seize everything, and leave. Ivy opens a women's rights firm; all three rebuild.

the-alphas-cursed-luna.copied_text: Aria goes to the hospital for a check-up but is accidentally inseminated with a powerful Alpha werewolf’s baby. Now trapped in a dangerous world, she must fight to protect herself and the life growing inside her.

forbidden-tides-don-t-tell-my-stepson.copied_text: Lisa's life takes a risky turn during a weekend trip when an irresistible passion sparks between her and Kai, her stepson’s college friend. Caught in an alluring web of secret encounters, she struggles to keep their forbidden affair hidden under her husband and stepson’s noses. As desire threatens to unravel her marriage, every choice pulls her deeper into the abyss.

the-mafia-s-forbidden-swap.copied_text: Emma is a beautiful mafia wife, ignored by her cold husband Kevin. Injured in a fall, she fakes amnesia, aching to feel loved—only for Kevin to name his brother Ryan, the feared "dark executioner," as her real husband while he flaunts his mistress. The dangerous swap throws her into the arms of a lethal man whose cold eyes hide scorching heat.

riding-with-my-bully-stepbrother.copied_text: After her mother remarries, Hayley is forced to spend a family vacation with her bully stepbrother, Cole. As old wounds give way to undeniable attraction, forbidden feelings and long-buried secrets threaten to change their relationship forever.

matchplay-love-action.copied_text: Noah, a former global idol, lands a role in a Hollywood action film as his last chance to rebuild his shattered image. But on set, he runs into Cade, the stunt coordinator, who refuses to go easy on the arrogant Noah and pushes him hard at every turn. As the two clash over everything, a strange tension quietly begins to simmer between them. Meanwhile, it turns out that Jun — an old bandmate — was behind the rumored discord that drove Noah out of the group Signal. Watching Noah grow closer to Cade with growing irritation, Jun soon figures out Cade's true identity and begins to work at unraveling the two men's relationship…

one-night-with-the-dragon-lord.copied_text: To keep her mother alive, Isolde marries the Dragon Lord in her sister's place — a monster who shreds every bride. She takes one free night first, with a stranger. Next morning he's on the throne. Her touch alone calms his curse, so she stays to use his army. Vael knows, and allows it. Then she learns her father cast the curse, and Vael carries her poison. He offers a blade. She takes the crown.

charming-the-campus-kings.copied_text: Between rent and her mom's hospital bills, romance was the last thing on scholarship student Grace's mind. But after a disastrous first encounter, she ends up tutoring Adrian—the rich football star she can't stand. They clash at every turn, but somewhere between the bickering, sparks start to fly. A college romance that was never part of the plan—and turns out to be the best thing in it.

fight-for-me-prison-king.copied_text: Reid Donovan sacrifices everything by taking the blame for the woman he loves, only to believe she abandoned him during his seven years in prison. Hardened into the feared Prison King, Reid returns seeking a new life—unaware that the truth behind her silence will change everything.

reborn-as-a-genius-baby.copied_text: Betrayed, framed, and murdered by his stepfather, Dylan wakes as his own six-year-old self every memory of the life that destroyed him intact. Armed with the future, he turns one insurance check into a fortune, lifts his mother from poverty, and unmasks the billionaire who's secretly his real father. But the family that buried him still wants it all. This time, the genius baby buries them first.

too-late-to-regret-my-lost-goddess.copied_text: Leila is secretly Zeus's granddaughter until Damon brands their unborn child a rapist's bastard to shield Callista. She seals the child in crystal, divorces him, then reveals the crystal bears both Ares's and Zeus's marks. She exposes Callista's scheme and calls down Olympus's judgment on her. Damon's sentence: not death, but eternal regret, forced to watch Leila live happily with Orion, forever.

my-baby-daddy-is-my-best-friend.copied_text: Jea finds herself at a crossroads after becoming pregnant with the child of Young-gi, a married man. Unable to give up her baby, she makes an unexpected proposal to her childhood friend Gu-in. Bound by circumstances he cannot refuse, Gu-in agrees to become her fake husband and the baby's father. What begins as a bizarre arrangement gradually turns into genuine affection as they raise the child together. But when Young-gi's wife, Kyung-ah, discovers the truth, everything spirals out of control. Caught in a tangled web of love, lies, and family, their outrageous romance takes an unpredictable turn.

the-dangerous-bosss-missing-bride.copied_text: For eight months, Kang Sung-hoe boss Lee Kanghyun has searched relentlessly for the woman who saved his life. When he finally finds her, she is Yoo Seoyeon — a woman raising a child alone, abandoned even by her own family. But then he notices something: the child's birthday matches the exact night he spent with her. "I'll take responsibility for you and the child." The world's most dangerous man begins to move — to protect the woman he loves and the child who may be his.

falling-into-a-dangerous-love.copied_text: To bear alone the weight of her father's gambling debts, her family's ruin, and the child growing inside her, brilliant designer Yun Jae-i cruelly pushes away the man she loves, Lee Taebin, with a heartless lie and walks away. Eight years later, Jae-i is a single mother raising her ailing son Yun Suho, while Taebin has become the cold and ruthless CEO behind Jinsung Group's rise — and he walks back into her life. Determined to have his revenge, Taebin finds himself torn between hatred and a love he cannot erase, growing dangerously obsessed with Jae-i. As eight years of misunderstanding slowly unravel and the truth of the child's paternity is finally revealed, what began as revenge is upended by regret — and a choice that could change everything.

i-slept-with-my-dad-s-best-friend.copied_text: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Hannah swears off love, until a chance meeting at a bar changes everything. The charming older man who makes her laugh and feel alive again seems too good to be true. Their summer fling turns passionate, but when Hannah discovers he’s her dad’s best friend, her world shatters. Now she must choose between her heart and the fallout of forbidden love.

matrimoney.copied_text: When a struggling dog-walker agrees to a 30-day fake engagement with a reckless underwear-model billionaire to save her sister, she expects a simple transaction. But sharing a mansion sparks explosive clashes, steamy hate-sex, and an undeniable connection. As jealousy ignites and feelings deepen, they must decide if their pretend marriage is just a deal—or the real love they’ve been avoiding.

under-the-hood.copied_text: After entering a marriage of convenience to save her family, Selene devoted herself to building her husband’s empire. But when a broken-down car leads her into the arms of a brooding mechanic, she’s forced to face a painful truth: the man she truly connects with isn’t her husband—and might be her greatest threat to freedom.

mated-to-my-rival-alpha.copied_text: When Ivy, a disowned Alpha heir, and Alex, her rival’s son, discover they’re bonded by a forbidden mark, they embark on a secret journey to break it. But the deeper they fall for each other, the more dangerous it becomes, because if their love is real, the curse will destroy them both.

i-accidentally-slept-with-my-professor.copied_text: Annie never expected her summer fling to become her professor. Their chemistry is electric, their connection undeniable—but secrets, jealousy, and scandal threaten to tear them apart. As passion blurs the lines between love and ruin, Annie must decide if he’s worth risking everything.

the-summer-i-fell-for-my-butler.copied_text: Ella thought she’d landed the fairy tale with a picture-perfect wedding to a picture-perfect man, Leo. But Leo ditched her for work on their honeymoon night, leaving her alone in a luxury beach house with Dylan, the butler with a crooked smile and a knack for saving dolphins, who makes her feel more like a bride than the groom ever did.

signed-sealed-deceived-by-my-billionaire.copied_text: Ellie falls hard for Colton, the charming mailroom clerk who sees her in a way no one else does. But the deeper she falls, the more she senses he’s hiding something. When she uncovers his true identity a billionaire heir tangled in a web of power and secrets—their forbidden love becomes a dangerous game of loyalty, lies, and desire.

quarterback-s-team-doctor.copied_text: When a star quarterback returns to his hometown team, he runs into the brilliant team doctor he never stopped loving—and discovers the son he never knew he had. Between healing old wounds and chasing new dreams, they get a second chance at love, family, and victory.

shaping-soulmate-my-soulmate-professor-i.copied_text: On the brink of graduation, art student Hannah is stunned when her unforgettable summer fling walks into class as her new professor. Caught in a forbidden romance, they must navigate secrets, obsession, betrayal, and academic power plays. As their love deepens, so do the stakes. Is this fated connection a second chance or the start of their undoing?

billionaire-alphas-fated-mate.copied_text: Billionaire Alpha’s Fated Mate tells the story of a woman abandoned at her wedding who finds a new beginning. In this sweeping romance, she becomes the fated partner of the world's strongest Alpha, proving that betrayal can lead to a destiny far greater than she ever imagined.

five-years-behind-bars-my-family-begs.copied_text: Five Years Behind Bars, My Family Begs follows Nova Sterling’s high-stakes journey of revenge after her own family sent her to prison. With a powerful CEO by her side, she exposes the truth in this trending mini drama. Will their late regrets be enough to earn her mercy?

love-on-replay.copied_text: Love on Replay tells the story of Rex, a man who wakes up in a future where his romance is failing. After drowning and returning to his wedding day, he attempts to escape his destiny. Can he avoid the marriage he once desired, or is he stuck in a loop?

my-sunshine-in-the-ruins.copied_text: In My Sunshine in the Ruins, an optimistic nurse named Anna attempts to melt the icy heart of Elias, a man hardened by the slums. Their blossoming romance proves that even in the darkest circumstances, love can provide the light needed to heal and start anew.

the-return-of-the-amnesiac-heiress.copied_text: In The Return of the Amnesiac Heiress, a long-lost daughter struggles with memory loss while her Billionaire mother searches for her. Trapped with a cheating boyfriend, Eun Seong is unaware of her true heritage and the powerful family waiting to bring her home.

testing-love-married-to-a-crippled-billi.copied_text: Tired of gold-diggers, tech mogul Alexander shows up to a blind date disguised as a poor disabled man. There he meets Morgan—a warmhearted mechanic who treats him with genuine kindness, flaws and all. They rush into marriage, but Alexander keeps his true identity hidden, quietly watching over her. Morgan's snobbish cousin Camilla constantly mocks them, yet her schemes only end in her own embarrassment. Alexander's mother grows close to Morgan, nearly slipping about who he really is. When the truth finally comes out, Morgan is hurt by the deception, but still loves Alexander. They reconcile, and soon Morgan is expecting twins—completing their happily-ever-after.

substitute-bride-conqueror-of-a-billiona.copied_text: After ten years locked in an asylum by her stepmother, Eliza is released and forced to take her sister's place as the bride of Cassius Blackwood—a ruthless, cold-hearted business tycoon. Everyone expected her to meet the same grim fate as Cassius's four previous wives. But Eliza, armed with the skills she honed in the asylum and a heart full of sincerity, healed the entire Blackwood family—and in return, found the love and the home she had always longed for.

sold-to-the-ice-king.copied_text:
Ice hockey king Damon is cold, arrogant — and secretly a mafia heir. Scholarly beauty Aria is bullied to the brink by Daisy. 
With her grandma dying and nowhere to run, she makes a deal with Damon: total obedience in exchange for saving her family, crushing her bullies, and becoming campus queen.
Their dangerous game of control and submission slowly turns into something real. The ice-cold monster falls for her gentle strength. The broken girl rises from hell.
From deadly bargain to desperate love — they drown together.

fifty-cents-to-find-my-billionaire-dad.copied_text: At eight, Gemma was illegally bought by the Carter family and abused for seven years. One snowy night, she was thrown out for taking a piece of spare rib. By a dumpster, she found a missing-child poster with her own face on it. With her last two quarters, she called the number listed and reached her biological father, billionaire Ethan Whitmore. He rushed to find her, and a hospital exam revealed years of old injuries. A DNA test confirmed with 99.9999% certainty that Gemma was the Whitmore family's long-lost daughter. As her abusers face justice, Gemma returns to her family's Manhattan penthouse and begins healing in the love of her parents.

his-private-patient.copied_text: Sophia, a bastard swapped at birth by her scheming mother, grows up eclipsed by her sister Laura, who steals every scrap of love and privilege. Forced into a cold marriage with Oscar, she endures a year of sexless neglect—her stifled desire curdling into hysteria. Then enters Brant, the hospital's enigmatic doctor. Their charged entanglement peels back decades of lies, exposing a birth secret that could shatter her world.

married-to-a-hidden-fortune.copied_text: 50-year-old single mother Anne loses her house after mortgaging it for her son's wedding. Homeless and desperate, she flash-marries Leonardo, a self-proclaimed "poor plumber." After marriage, she discovers he is the 10th-generation heir of the Windsor family—a trillion-dollar financial empire. Even more unexpectedly, the girl who set them up, Rebecca, turns out to be Bella, her biological daughter lost 20 years ago. From a lower-class mother humiliated by her in-laws and deceived by her daughter-in-law into donating a kidney, Anne rises to become the wife of a billionaire—and reclaims her long-lost family.

they-don-t-know-i-m-the-don-s-pregnant-q.copied_text: She married New York's mafia king — but her family doesn't know. Eight months pregnant, she comes home and they treat her like trash: starve her, smash his ring, put a dog collar on her, slice her belly. They laugh at her "nobody husband." But that nobody owns the city — and she's its queen. One call brings helicopters, armored cars, and everyone pays.

the-stock-queen-returns.copied_text: Louise, the 'never-wrong' stock market queen of Alice Group, secretly married David and helped his company go public. But when the scheming Carol interfered, Louise vowed revenge—divorcing David and revealing her true identity. Then came Simon, her unexpected light. In the end, her choice was...?"

one-night-one-deal-one-billionaire.copied_text: In order to cover her father’s surgery fees, college student Emily Anderson becomes entangled in a dangerous financial arrangement with Grayson Blackwood—the cold, alluring heir to the Blackwood family. What begins as a transactional relationship of mutual benefit spirals into an addictive obsession with each other’s bodies, intensifying the battle between morality and desire. As their connection deepens, unspoken emotions slowly unravel: Grayson finds himself captivated by her tenderness and resilience, while Emily undergoes a transformative rebirth under his protection, ultimately stepping into a new life.

love-at-50-from-janitor-to-billionaires-.copied_text: To dodge a marriage arranged by her daughter-in-law, Sophia Reed pretends to remarry. At the same time, Ethan Carter tells the same lie to reassure his daughter before she leaves the country. The two enter a fake marriage. A year later, Sophia—now working as a janitor—ends up cleaning the office of her fake husband, who turns out to be the CEO… but neither of them recognizes the other.

from-one-night-to-mrs-billionaire.copied_text: Claudia is the adopted daughter of the richest man, Kaden. She drugged and framed Anastasia, wanting to ruin her reputation and divorce her husband Lucius. However, Anastasia was rescued by the drunk Kaden by mistake and became pregnant with Kaden's only child. Clarissa, relying on her status as the richest man's adopted daughter, was arrogant and domineering, targeting Anastasia at the company and at the banquet, but she didn't know that Kaden had taken Anastasia home to take care of her and fell in love with her. In the end, Claudia's true identity was also discovered by Kaden...

undercover-in-the-mafia-queen-s-bed.copied_text: Rookie police officer Scarlett is manipulated by her boyfriend into going undercover to approach mafia queen Raven. Yet as Raven repeatedly protects her through one life-threatening crisis after another, Scarlett realizes that her supposed target is the only person who truly respects and cares for her. She gradually breaks free from emotional manipulation, joins forces with Raven to expose the conspiracy and punish their enemies.

pregnant-with-the-mafia-boss-s-triplets-.copied_text: Amy Brooks dreams of becoming a dancer. During a performance, she crosses paths with John Wilson, a mafia boss caught in a shootout. She saves him, and the two end up spending the night together. Amy unexpectedly falls pregnant with triplets. When her parents and younger sister find out about her pregnancy, they subject her to endless humiliation. Worse still, they plan to send her to an auction to be sold. Meanwhile, John Wilson is searching relentlessly for Amy Brooks, yet the pair keep missing each other time and again

neon-sin-stepfather-s-touch.copied_text: Emma, who had just turned 18, was raised by her single mother. To celebrate her coming-of-age, her mother rented out an entire bar for a grand birthday party and had her 35-year-old new husband—the muscular, mature James—take Emma out to dance and mingle. On the crowded dance floor, the close physical contact instantly ignited a twisted desire between them. The bar filled with guests, James and Emma gradually crossed moral boundaries. Under the cover of the music and the crowd, Emma ultimately completed her “coming-of-age ritual” .

bring-it-on-my-mafia-life.copied_text: Sold for five million, Rhea was traded by her parents to the mafia Lukas. While Lukas was supposed to treat her as a mere plaything, he unexpectedly went to great lengths to protect her in the perilous world of the mafia. Does he genuinely love her, or is he merely considering her as part of a dangerous yet thrilling game?

fated-at-first-sight.copied_text: Isabel, the hot-headed daughter of the Blood Moon Pack's Alpha, encounters the enigmatic Drake while fleeing from Ravagers. Amidst the chaos, she feels an unfamiliar attraction, complicated by her protective brother Tristan's interference. As she seeks vengeance for her father's murder, Isabel uncovers that Drake is her destined mate, just as Tristan begins to act strangely…

happy-ever-after-with-my-grooms-brother.copied_text: A powerful billionaire masquerading as a wheelchair bound "nobody." A bride who proposes to him midwedding to spite her cheating fiancé. Trapped in a marriage of convenience, their explosive chemistry blurs the lines between deception and desire. As his double life unravels, Mia discovers the man she vowed to protect is Europe’s most elusive tycoon. But with forbidden sparks igniting, can their game of lies survive a world of gold-digging schemers, jealous exes, and sizzling midnight confessions?

when-my-ex-becomes-my-gynecologist.copied_text:
Grace nervously spreads her legs for a routine exam, only to realize the doctor is the ex she abandoned five years ago!  She never expected her life to fall apart on a gynecology table, coming face to face with Blade, now a world-renowned gynecologist. What she doesn’t know is that their breakup was built on a devastating misunderstanding, and that he never stopped loving her. Forced back into each other’s lives, her most intimate care is now in the hands of this "very personal doctor". 
When Grace blushes and mutters, "My private matters are none of your business!"
Blade pulls her tightly in his arms, his voice low and dangerous: "Every inch of you has always been mine… and this time, I’m not letting you slip away again."

my-boyfriend-gave-my-virginity-to-his-br.copied_text: Emma plans to lose her virginity to her boyfriend Blake on her birthday. When a chandelier falls and knocks her out, Emma wakes up with amnesia. To cover up the fact that he’s been cheating with Emma’s best friend, Blake tells Emma she's dating his best friend, Dylan. Emma believes him and starts dating Dylan, only to find out Dylan’s big secret—he’s been secretly in love with her for years! When Emma finally gets her memory back, she cries out shouting, “You lied to me!” Dylan pulls her tight against his chest and says, “The only thing I lied about was pretending I didn’t want you all this time!”

after-i-buy-sperm-from-a-billionaire.copied_text:
"So, how much is your sperm?"

"Excuse me?"

I looked at the man across from me, wondering why someone so handsome would be donating sperm. But it didn't matter—I just wanted to buy some sperm, get pregnant, and fulfill my mother's last wish.

He gave me a once-over, then smiled.

"I can give it to you for free, as long as you agree to sign a contract with me."

Wait, what? The contract says we’d co-parent the baby? And this guy turns out to be the richest man in LA? I think I might’ve walked into the wrong place…

revenge-of-the-forsaken-elf-queen.copied_text: Half elf and gifted with extraordinary magic, Freya Windsor hides her true power and gives up the battlefield to become an ordinary wife. When her husband betrays her for a celebrated war hero, Freya trades her family’s military honors for a divorce and puts her armor back on. But exposing Olivia’s stolen glory is only the beginning—because it may lead Freya straight to the truth behind her family’s massacre.

my-freeze-their-tears-no-forgiveness.copied_text:
Adopted into the wealthy Johnson family at six, Sophie was once their most treasured daughter.
But when their biological daughter returns, she becomes the one everyone blames and abandons.
Heartbroken, she enters her brother’s life-changing sleep experiment, leaving behind the family she once loved. Thirty years later, they finally want her back—but she no longer remembers them.

dont-provoke-him-hes-the-king-of-l-a.copied_text: Cain Morgan, founder of APEX Capital, works as a taxi driver in seclusion after his eldest son Ethan dies in a premeditated car crash caused by Damian O’Hara. His younger son Liam clashes repeatedly with the wealthy O’Hara family, who kidnap Liam’s girlfriend Aurora to threaten him. Cain unleashes his financial power and bankrupts O’Hara Group for revenge. Later he meets Lena, chairwoman of Opal, and invests heavily in her brand. Lena’s ex Holton, consumed by jealousy, abducts her at Westside Warehouse and forces Cain to kneel and hand over APEX shares. Holton is arrested in the end. Liam transfers to the finance department to marry Aurora, while Cain and Lena stay together.

mr-williams-madame-is-dying.copied_text:
Thumbs up for this piece! How could he be so heartless and treat his wife rudely?
Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea  David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea  David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison  Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

betrayed-at-the-alter-she-married-a-ceo-.copied_text:
For eight years, heiress Ella Whitfield hid her identity and gave everything to the man she loved.
On their wedding day, she discovers he’s been sleeping with his late brother’s widow—and raising their five-year-old son. Humiliated and betrayed, Ella walks away and takes back every resource she ever gave him. He thought he lost a bride. He’s about to find out he lost the woman who built his entire world.

loving-you-in-my-final-days.copied_text: She pretended to betray the man she loved to hide a terminal illness. A year later, he returns as a billionaire CEO—with another woman by his side and nothing but resentment for her. Every reunion reopens old wounds, while the truth remains buried between them. When love was built on one heartbreaking lie, can the truth still bring them back together?

the-tiny-tyrant-of-go.copied_text: In the gritty urban backdrop, the destitute Master Glenn, unable to care for his young disciple Anna, sends the child down the mountain to seek refuge at the Nova Go Club under Master Parker Jordan.To everyone’s shock, the tiny prodigy cracks the “Sovereign Gambit”—a Go puzzle unsolved for 20 years—overnight. Parker Jordan takes Anna into the club, but crisis strikes again when the ruthless “Go King”Owl storms in for a showdown.Calm and unstoppable, Anna dismantles Owl’s attacks move by move, forcing the defeated king to his knees—begging to become her disciple.When the dust settles, Parker Jordan confides in Anna his lifelong obsession: entering the legendary “Zenith Go Championship” to uncover the truth behind his wife’s death. And so—their fated journey begins.

when-she-stopped-chasing-his-love.copied_text:
Camellia was born with a gift for piano, but after losing hearing in one ear, her family gave up on her.
To keep chasing music, she accepted Dylan’s help—and became the stand-in for the woman he truly loved: her sister, Malory.
Three years later, Malory returns. Camellia finally sees the truth and decides to leave.
But when she walks away, a mysterious music producer sees her talent.
And Dylan begins to realize… he lost the wrong woman.

the-billionaires-rescue.copied_text:
After their encounter, he became a patron saint to protect her all the time.
Emily works tirelessly at a bar to save money for college, but her life takes a dark turn when she's assaulted by a customer. In her darkest moment, Luke heroically intervenes, saving her and sparking a deep emotional connection between them. Initially determined to raise her unexpected child alone, Emily reconsiders when Luke reappears, offering unwavering support and love. Their budding romance faces a formidable challenge with the sudden reemergence of Luke’s ex-fiancée, Clara, who is bent on tearing them apart. The stakes rise when Clara uncovers a shocking secret: Emily is the true heiress of the Cassano family, switched at birth in a malicious plot. Desperate to keep this secret, Clara schemes against Emily, but her plans ultimately unravel.Reclaimed by her rightful family, Emily witnesses Clara face the consequences of her actions. Amidst the revelations and justice, Emily and Luke's love triumphs. They celebrate their journey with a grand wedding, their story becoming a legend of enduring love and resilience, as they step into a blissful married life together.

a-flash-marriage-with-the-billionaire-ty.copied_text: Elise was a normal accountant of Hawthorn Group. She worked very carefully to avoid any problem, but she made a huge mistake despite of her caution. She was on a business trip and was drunk, then she accidentally had an one-night stand with her boss Lucian. Her fate had changed since then...

justice-in-blood.copied_text:
Five years ago, he lost everything—family, love, and a life he once knew.
Now he’s back, forged by blood and fire. He walks straight into the city’s darkest syndicate… and takes it apart from the inside. Because this time, justice isn’t clean—and neither is he.

married-to-a-fisherman-but-he-is-poseido.copied_text: In her past life, Aloryn was killed after marrying First Prince Adrian. Reborn with a second chance, she rejects her family’s control and chooses to marry Neptune, a fisherman despised by everyone around her. Though they live a poor but peaceful life, the Sea God’s Festival draws them into conflicts involving the royal family, House Sterling, and the Sea Temple. Even as her family humiliates and torments her, Aloryn remains kind and steadfast. When she faces danger, the Mother of Gods, Rhea, appears to test her, while Neptune’s true identity is finally revealed: he is actually Poseidon, the Sea God. In the end, Aloryn earns divine recognition, becomes Queen of the Seven Seas, and rules beside Poseidon.

dragonfire-and-the-sacred-sword.copied_text: The overlooked Princess Aelia Aelin draws the Sacred Sword, forms a Lifebound Covenant with a young dragon Silvermoon, frees the enslaved dragons, defeats the tyrant Mordes, and ultimately becomes Queen of Aelin.
